records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project or key milestone, and no reply to either outreach (email:405e0ba4, email:47e6d165) suggests low engagement. One invite sent shows some intent, and Pro paid status plus 8 days left leaves a real but modest chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for getting started with Wrenfield, and for sending your first teammate invite. The usual next step is creating a first project, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through that first project with you. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
